scenarios.name: colored-mana-unavailable-without-basic-land-after-entry-turn
scenarios.why: The Fortress is present before turn one, so its entry-turn alternative is false; with no basic land controlled, the colored ability is unavailable and colorless mana remains available.

scenarios.name: colored-mana-available-with-basic-land
scenarios.why: A basic Swamp meets the alternative restriction; selecting the black choice taps the Fortress and adds black mana.
